elements.name: loft-03 Preview and create a solid from two circular sections

steps.name: a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/parallel-circles.opd" is open
both circular sketches on separate parallel planes are visible
their circular edges are selected in a fresh Loft dialog
the Sections list contains both sketches and a tapered solid preview appears
OK is clicked with the default settings
Loft1 appears in the browser and the part contains one solid body
